statements: 数値予測の Consumer を定義する

numerical_prediction_consumer.ranking: local_krs_bridge_candidate.build_candidate_prediction (existing v0.1 candidate arithmetic) on the Production Full29 values; overall = mean(W,P2,P3 role scores); ties by horse number

role_widths.source: Owner Static v1.1 widths (the candidate 40/67/85% widths are NOT used)

numerical_prediction_consumer.static_owner_v1_1: kept as a frozen shadow ledger (ordinal ranking recorded, not consumed)
numerical_prediction_consumer.pre_decision_evidence: 2026-11-16 retrospective replay on 5 signed races (NOT OOS): Static 528pt PFS 43.5% / candidate ranking + Static widths 528pt PFS 23.3% / candidate widths 1,908pt PFS 9.4%

local_ticket_cap.scope: LOCAL formal recommendation only; MEC R3 (family common) unchanged
local_ticket_cap.rule: From the Runtime-signed FINAL MEC ticket set, keep at most 60 tickets ordered by MEC tier (CORE, PROTECTION, TAIL), then by the sum of numerical ranks of the selection, then MEC order; dropped coverage units recorded
local_ticket_cap.signed_final_relation: Signed FINAL keeps the full MEC R3 set (Runtime contract: total == MEC minimum capital, coverage 1.0). The capped recommendation is a deterministic, pre-cutoff, sha-bound derivative of that signed set, delivered and settled as the formal recommendation; the Runtime signed RESULT settles the full signed set.
local_ticket_cap.mec_r3_conflict: acknowledged by Owner (coverage-breaking reduction and fixed caps are outside MEC R3)
